_meta.tone: Plain. One number per sentence. No bureaucratic nouns — 'channelizing agency' becomes 'the SC development corporation office'. Never 'may be eligible'. Never a list longer than three.
_meta.build_check: hi.json and en.json must carry identical key sets; scripts/check_phase0.py asserts it.
